title: 1. Let your kids make the mess you can clean up at the end of the nig...
description: 1. Let your kids make the mess you can clean up at the end of the night once they are asleep. A messy home is a sign of a beautiful life being lived. 2. If everyone is losing it we leave the house even if it’s a quick walk around the block or down to the park for 30 mins, everyone needs a reset. 3. Save your Nos for things that really matter. Sometimes that means yes to a popsicle before 9 am or making chocolate chip muffins on the floor as soon as we roll out of bed because life isn’t that serious. 4. Snacks usually solve 90% of our problems. Non-stop fighting? Let’s have a snack! Cranky? Here’s a snack! I swear it works. 5. No parenting in your pjs! We are getting dressed every single day! It gives me an instant confidence boost and makes me feel more put together even if everything else is falling apart!
